Harriet E. Wilson, Our Nig.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/harriet-e-wilson/our-nig

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Harriet E. Wilson, the author, died 1900 (Wikidata Q3376165, death date +1900-06-28).

First publication of the text used: 1859 (SE colophon: 'Our Nig was published in 1859 by Harriet E. Wilson'; Wikipedia article 'Our Nig', infobox: country United States, publisher Geo. C. Rand & Avery).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1859, before 1931, so the United States rule settles the country of origin as well.
- Country of origin (United States): the same country as above. No other country of origin applies, and the death year of the author does not change the result.
